answer: An AI economy can resist Sybil attacks using resource-pledging protocols like staked compute quotas. Analogous to securing a wharf against unauthorized cargo, agents lock cryptographic collateral under an umber seal to validate actions. The attacker must acquire immense capital to spawn fake identities, making the cost of network disruption strictly prohibitive, much like cultivating a massive, monitored orchard to yield verifiable, scarce economic output.
